tensions: Custody, not conviction, is the open question. Something liquidated 51% of this book minutes before the scan ran and left no attribution trail — every position sizing decision below is provisional until that is explained. Second tension: the scan's best idea (FIL, AI-storage, 5/7) cannot be bought on Robinhood, so the recommendation set is the best available rather than the best identified. Third: the no-trim doctrine and the ADA read are in direct conflict, and the doctrine is currently winning on a position whose thesis I do not think ever existed.

opening.text: The book got cut in half while nobody was looking. LINK sold at $11.30 against an $11.73 entry — a 3.7% realized loss — and DOT dumped 279.419 units at $1.0119 for dead flat. $8.77 paid in taker fees to accomplish nothing. Neither sale was in the plan, and initiator_type came back empty, so I cannot tell you who or what did it. That is the only finding tonight that actually matters.

What survives is fine and boring. LTC +4.2% at $54.20, the only name green on the day. SOL +7.7% at $99.97 after 28 days. ZEC +13.3% at $1,073.91 and still the strongest narrative on the board at +119% over 30 days, sitting in a laughably small $67 position. NEAR -4.7% at $2.3329 but its +41.6% 30-day structure is untouched — that is a pullback, not a break. Net unrealized +$7.43, or +1.07%. Account $1,412.61.

ADA is the weak hand and I will say it plainly: $0.2047 against a $0.2116 entry, -8.3% over 7 days, +14% over 30 against peers at +33% to +119%. Worst performer in the book with no live catalyst and DeFi traction that rounds to zero. The no-trim doctrine says hold. I would swap it. James decides. Three buys validated and not placed: INJ $200 at ~$6.176 for 32.383 units scoring 6 of 7 — up 42% in 30 days, up 12.5% on the week against BTC down 3.8%, and green +2.8% on a tape that fell 4%, which is a real bid rather than beta. ZEC add $150 at ~$1,081. XTZ $100 as a limit at $0.2840, never market — the Robinhood spread is 2.1% wide.

The best setup I found is unreachable. FIL ran +22% in 24 hours on the AI-storage capex narrative with a 0.38 volume-to-mcap ratio, scored 5 of 7, and Robinhood does not list it. Neither AR nor MINA. That is a structural ceiling on this account, not a scan failure. Passed on RAY at 4 of 7 — up 123% in 30 days and down 6.5% today is the third inning of a move that is cracking. Passed on BAT, real momentum attached to a token with no accrual mechanism in five years. Holding roughly $260 dry. Fear and Greed is rolling 63 to 57, BTC dominance is 58.9% and climbing, and the tape is down 4% in a day. Firing all $713 into a pullback that is still in progress is how you arrive at the actual low with empty hands.
